title: ELAB: Extensive LLM Alignment Benchmark in Persian Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating target model responses to generated adversarial questions focused on gender stereotypes and gender preference biases using an LLM-as-a-judge approach.
Evaluating target model responses to generated adversarial questions focused on racial and ethnic stereotypes and preference biases using an LLM-as-a-judge approach.

Assessing model alignment with culturally specific norms (e.g., Persian concepts of 'taarof' and 'aberoo'), cultural preferences, and cultural insensitivity using translated datasets and generated queries evaluated by an LLM-as-a-judge.
Evaluating target model responses to questions focusing on occupational stereotypes and occupational preference biases using an LLM-as-a-judge.
Evaluating target model responses to generated queries targeting age-related stereotypes using an LLM-as-a-judge.
Assessing dialect fairness and linguistic insensitivity within the Persian language using a generated dataset (SocialBench-fa) and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
